description: This file defines a class `Translation` within the Opencart admin controller namespace. The class contains methods to add, edit, and delete translation data by creating tasks for these operations. It acts as an event listener that responds to changes in translation entities and schedules corresponding background tasks.

classes.name: Translation
classes.description: A controller class handling events related to translation entities, specifically adding, editing, and deleting translation tasks.

methods.name: addTranslation
methods.description: Handles the event after a translation is added; schedules a task to generate translation info.

methods.name: editTranslation
methods.description: Handles the event after a translation is edited; schedules a task to update translation info.

methods.name: deleteTranslation
methods.description: Handles the event after a translation is deleted; schedules a task to remove translation info.
